findings.title: Adapt legacy messages before using the V2 codec
findings.claim: The default codec rejects V1-only generated protobuf messages that were accepted at the base.
findings.trigger: Messages generated by the original Go protobuf generator, such as `SearchRequestV3` in the retained reflection fixture, lack `ProtoReflect`.
findings.impact: Changing this import makes both existing `proto.Message` assertions require V2 messages, so the default codec now rejects these messages and their RPCs fail with `Internal`; the same round trip succeeds with the base codec.
findings.change: Accept V1 and V2 messages and adapt V1 values with `protoadapt.MessageV2Of` before both marshal and unmarshal operations.

evidence.text:
`testv3.go` was generated with an older version of codegen, to test reflection
behavior with `grpc.SupportPackageIsVersion3`. DO NOT REGENERATE!

`testv3.go` was then manually edited to replace `"golang.org/x/net/context"`
with `"context"`.

`dynamic.go` was generated with a newer protoc and manually edited to remove
everything except the descriptor bytes var, which is renamed and exported.

findings.title: Unwrap legacy protobuf messages returned by Details
findings.claim: Status.Details returns the V2 adapter for a registered V1-only protobuf detail instead of the original concrete message type returned at the base.
findings.trigger: For a registered V1-only detail, `WithDetails` still succeeds, but `any.UnmarshalNew()` returns a V2 adapter.
findings.impact: Appending that adapter directly changes `Details()[0]` from the generated type to `*impl.messageIfaceWrapper`; existing type switches miss the detail and direct type assertions panic. A round trip with the retained `SearchRequestV3` fixture reproduces the regression, while the base implementation returns the original type.
findings.change: Append `protoadapt.MessageV1Of(detail)` so legacy details are unwrapped before returning them.

findings.title: Preserve legacy message payloads in binary log construction
findings.claim: TruncatingMethodLogger.Build silently emits an empty payload and length zero for V1-only ClientMessage.Message and ServerMessage.Message values that base serialized.
findings.trigger: With binary logging enabled, a unary server using a configured codec that supports V1-only messages passes the original reply to `ServerMessage` (`server.go:1470`).
findings.impact: The new import makes its message assertion fail, leaving `data` nil and recording length zero despite a successful RPC; direct legacy `ClientMessage` inputs lose their payload too. The focused check records zero bytes at head versus nine at base.
findings.change: Adapt V1 inputs before the new `proto.Marshal` call in both message constructors.
